KONET is a Layer-1 blockchain designed with a focus on real-world usability, supporting scalable network operations and a wide range of applications, including payment-related environments.
It incorporates an EIP-1559-based fee mechanism, enabling dynamic fee adjustment based on network demand and a supply management model, along with an optimized node structure for stable network performance.
KONET is also designed to support integration with offline payment environments, where transaction data generated during payment processes can be recorded on-chain to ensure data integrity and transparency. This enables verifiable transaction records and blockchain-based receipt issuance, enhancing usability in real-world payment scenarios.
KONET extends beyond a general-purpose blockchain, positioning itself as an on-chain transaction processing and recording infrastructure suitable for practical service and payment use cases.
